visualCharacteristics.purpose: logged-out view of the eJournals download: login notice with 'Go to login', booking code field and 'To free download' button, all leading to lufthansa.com
traits: light grey info box with an info icon, copy and a bold arrow link
underlined 335px text field with the label inside
yellow primary button, full width below 768px

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value, all optional: Login link | link (default: live Travel ID login returning to the page), Live page | link (default: www.lufthansa.com + path + #login), Notice label, Login label, Field label, Submit label (defaults: labels/common, labels/ejournals, built-in en/de).

reuseGuidance: Author an empty block. Render-only: no request but the label bundles; the live app does the booking lookup after the hand-off.
